title: UsageEvent
description: Metered usage record for reporting and reconciliation. Source of truth: DSL Best Practices Chapter 11.04 (Usage Event Object).

leaseId.description: Lease to which the usage applies.

isvId.description: ISV identifier. NOTE (delta D3, spec-gap): optional pending spec adoption.

timestamp.description: Time at which the usage occurred.

workId.description: Correlation identifier for deployment or workflow.

submittedAt.description: Time the event reached the control plane (may differ from timestamp if buffered).

$comment: Deduplication key per Chapter 11.04 / 10.06: leaseId + timestamp + dimension (+ workId). Aligned with the implementation UsageRecord model.
